lines: Socrates. Why have you come at this time, Crito? Or isn’t it still early? Crito. Yes, very early. Socrates. About what time? Crito. Just before dawn. Socrates. I am surprised that the watchman of the prison was willing to let you in. Crito. He is used to me by this time, Socrates, because I come here so often, and besides I have done something for him. Socrates. Have you just come, or some time ago? Crito. Some little time ago.
